Write the comparison as a short Markdown summary

Source: R/markdown.R
write_dossier_md.Rd

A summary for a pull-request comment or a chat message: the version pair, how many steps were compared, the differences by kind, the most severe differences with their NEWS candidates, the steps that error under both versions, the determinism check, and a link to the full report when report_url is given. The first line is the HTML comment <!-- pkgdossier -->, so a bot can find and update its own comment.

Usage

write_dossier_md(x, path = NULL, report_url = NULL, max_rows = 20L)

Arguments

x

An pkgdossier_comparison from compare_runs().

path

File to write (its folder is created if needed), or NULL to return the text.

report_url

Optional link to the full report (for example the workflow run that holds it as an artifact).

max_rows

Most severe differences listed at most.

Value

The Markdown text (a single string) when path is NULL, otherwise path, invisibly.

Details

The template system.file("github", "pkgdossier.yaml", package = "pkgdossier") is a GitHub Actions workflow that runs a dossier on each pull request and posts this summary as a comment.

Examples

# \donttest{
d <- example_dossier()
prepare_versions(d, quiet = TRUE)
run_scenarios(d, quiet = TRUE)
cmp <- compare_runs(d)
cat(write_dossier_md(cmp))
#> <!-- pkgdossier -->
